_about: Text changes the web build makes to its COPY of the shell; the source is never edited. Each 'find' must occur exactly once in its file, or the build stops, so a shell change that affects the web wording is caught. {keys} becomes the game's keysHelp from its web.json. A game's own changes go in its web.json.

replace.why: On the web, CrazyGames serves the ads, and Ad breaks only follow level-ups
replace.replace:
const SETTINGS_NOTE_ADS = 'Free to play, with ads served by CrazyGames. Some are optional and earn rewards; past level 10, '
  + 'a short ad may also play after a level-up, announced by an Ad break screen. No purchases. {keys}';

replace.why: A browser, not a phone; and the keys
replace.find: const SETTINGS_NOTE_NO_ADS = 'No ads and no purchases. Your progress stays on this phone.';
replace.replace: const SETTINGS_NOTE_NO_ADS = 'No ads and no purchases. Your progress is saved in this browser. {keys}';
